title: Rule 07 — Handy time expressions
short: Time vocabulary has reusable, low-effort patterns.
syntax:
heute / morgen / gestern
am Montag / am Freitag
um 14 Uhr / um halb drei
body: Use heute for today, morgen for tomorrow, gestern for yesterday. For a weekday use am. For a precise clock time use um. German halb drei means 2:30, not 3:30.
pitfall: German halb drei is 2:30. If a time matters, repeat it back or write it down.
